memories.text: Think like the audience, not a marketer. The plays that worked (Shuffle paying Jack Doherty to stop posting, Duel's offensive blackjack, Stake's logo on every viral video, a guy gambling on a kitchen-store fridge) were each ONE real act aimed at a feeling people already had: hate, outrage, love, wtf. Not a series, not a campaign, not a TikTok POV. One sentence, raw, a first, and impossible to retell without the brand's name. Fluffy, cringe or series-based ideas are dead.

Get Cashy in front of as many people as possible with things that are good on their own and subtly carry Cashy's name (posting account, watermark, logo in the corner). Never an idea that tells people why Cashy is great.

swipes.title: Asking for directions in LA using GTA 5 map
swipes.author: @itsHunterTV
swipes.why: So simple yet effective: one real act (asking strangers for directions in LA with the GTA 5 map), real reactions, zero cost, riding GTA 6 hype.
